mentions.name: claude-brief
mentions.description: A live session summariser for Claude Code that docks a pane next to the terminal (supporting iTerm2, tmux, kitty, ghostty, and Apple Terminal) showing a running summary of what the current session is doing, letting users re-orient across multiple Claude Code terminals at a glance. It is distributed as a Claude Code plugin.
mentions.problem: The author kept losing track of too many Claude Code terminals running at once, tabbing between them with no idea where each session was.
